## OutreachOS
URL: https://techxtreme.me/work/outreachos
Live: https://outreachos.techxtreme.me
Type: Production SaaS / lead management
Summary: Personal lead vault for cold outreach. Excel import, niche/country/status filters, sticky call scripts, CSV export, sketchbook UI, Supabase auth, per-account privacy. Demo peek available.
Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, Vercel

## Project AP-I
URL: https://techxtreme.me/work/project-ap-i
Live: https://project-ap-i.vercel.app
Type: R&D + automation pipeline
Summary: Short-form content intake → download → FFmpeg watermark → AI metadata → Drive staging → YouTube + Instagram publish for Memes / Anime / Sports niches. Operator dashboard with jobs, failed review, account health. Local worker + Vercel app.
Stack: Next.js, Supabase, yt-dlp, FFmpeg, Playwright, n8n
